description: An || with a null first operand and a false second operand is an error
notes: The spec contradicts itself here. The Logic Operators section says that an operand of the dynamic pseudo-type makes the result unknown, and the null keyword is a null of that type, but the section on unknown values says: "Calling applications are guaranteed that unless the global scope includes unknown values, or the function table includes functions that return unknown values, no expression will evaluate to an unknown value." With no true operand, hashicorp/hcl calls cty's OrFunc (cty/function/stdlib/bool.go), which doesn't accept null arguments (function.Call in cty/function/function.go), so this is an error while null || true is true.
